title: How to use a freight broker cold calling script on Mac for results
metaTitle: Freight Broker Cold Calling Script: Strategies for Mac Users
description: Learn to improve your freight broker cold calling script and prospecting workflow on your Mac to drive more booked loads and reduce admin time.
intro: A freight broker cold calling script works best when it acts as a guide rather than a rigid set of lines. You need to balance structure with the ability to pivot when a shipper raises a real objection.
tldr: Stop reading scripts verbatim; use them as a framework for discovery.
Focus on industry data to build credibility instead of generic sales pitches.
Use your Mac to automate the research phase so you can focus on the call.
Track your conversion rate from first contact to booked load, not just dials per day.

blocks.text: Why your freight broker cold calling script fails

Most brokers fail because they treat cold calling like a numbers game. They dial 100 people and say the exact same thing to everyone. This approach ignores the reality of the freight market. Shippers do not care about your capacity if you do not understand their specific lane challenges. When you sound like every other broker, you get blocked or ignored.
The high cost of manual prospecting

The biggest cost is not the phone bill. It is the opportunity cost of your time. If you spend your morning manually entering data into your CRM or searching for contact info, you are not selling. You are doing data entry. High-performing brokers use their Mac to handle the research before they pick up the phone.

items: Use FreightWaves SONAR to find market data before you call a prospect.
Focus on a niche vertical to become a subject matter expert.
Practice objection handling with a colleague or AI tool before calling real shippers.
Shift your KPIs to focus on conversion rates rather than total dials.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps your sales workflow

Lazur helps by keeping your research and your call notes in one place. When you are on a call, you can ask Lazur to summarize a company website or find recent news about a prospect. It keeps you focused on the conversation instead of the keyboard.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my TMS?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your Mac screen. It can see your TMS and help you find information, but it does not click buttons or edit data inside the TMS for you.

faq.question: Is my prospect data safe with Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut. It does not store your screen content or audio, and it never uses your data to train AI models.
